reviews.title: A great card for in-the-middle of the road PC users like myself.
reviews.comment: A very nice Vid card. It was a snap to install. A very decently performing card. It's not really that loud in terms of normal daily operating levels. I'm a non-serious gamer. Maybe on occasion play with UnReal Engine a bit, but I'm not push the card that hard all the time. For the price, getting 10G of video memory is very good. I did not need a very pricey card. If I were a serious UnReal engine developer, then yes, I'd have to ram it up a bit in overall cost like in the 300 bucks and above range. But for me, mostly on YouTube, some video editing, it fills the need nicely.  I also have a 14th gen Intel I5 with 32GB of ram. So, if I wanted to push it a bit, then the power is there. So, do I recommend it? Yes, if you're a middle level PC user like me and was looking in the 250-dollar range like me, then I'd give this one a deep look. Yes, the card fit in my PC case well. I do have a 600W PSU, which I'd advise for future expansion.

reviews.title: For Stat Nerds. (Good Discrete GPU)
reviews.comment:
Gaming OC Instructions:
Graphics-> Low Latency Mode; Change to On + Boost.
Intel Driver Software -> Performance -> Basic Tuning button.
Voltage 100%, Power 105%, Frequency Offset 150.
VRAM Tuning: 19.15
90-100 FPS on Palworld, Ultra except the last 3 including shadows which are high.
I also notice alot better color accuracy with this GPU relative to my 6800xt.
Summary:
Slight overclock makes this arc == a default 6800xt OC.
Considering the market right now, this GPU is high bang for buck.
GPU itself is extremely sturdy, sticks in its socket well and only requires 1 8pin PCIe.
I also enabled smooth vsync (Its version of Enhanced Sync more or less) and I enjoy gaming on this as much as my 6800xt.
I strongly recomend this GPU for budget gamers and anyone needing a GPU for a newbie, particularly if they WANT to try to OC but dont have the skill yet. This GPU has alota failsafes to prevent you from breaking your own device. Bad for OC enthusiests but great for first-timers. Enthusiests will like this GPU for its small size, cool temps and quiet operation plus its video and streaming capabilities. Newbies will enjoy ease of use, OC options if they wish to tinker and a cheap option for budget gaming.
However- You MUST overclock this GPU to get my results. Without it, youre looking at 60-75 FPS.

reviews.title: A great upgrade for me
reviews.comment:
Its been a huge improvement over my previous 1050 ti that's for sure! Its been a month since I've been using it and so far its been running great with no problems. Been great for Helldivers 2, Arc Raiders and Wuthering Waves. Wuthering Waves looks stunning so far and I can actually see trees in Arc Raiders instead of blocks!! The Intel Graphics software you need for it so far gets the job done. Haven't had any issues so far but I'll update if anything goes wrong.
All in all, I bought it for $227 so at around that price I would recommend it.
(P.S. Yes, my cable management is flawless I know.)
